question: In which of the following years was the Child Marriage Restraint Act passed?
solution:
The correct answer is **1929**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Child Marriage Restraint Act** was passed in the year **1929**.
 
• It is also known as the **Sarda Act**, named after Harbilas Sarda.
 
• The Act aimed to curb the practice of **child marriages** in India.
 
• It set the minimum age of marriage for **girls at 14** years and for **boys at 18** years.
 
• The Act was later amended to increase the minimum age for girls to **18 years** and for boys to **21 years**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Objective**
 To prevent child marriages and protect the rights of children.
 
 

 **Key Provisions**
 Minimum age for marriage set at 18 for girls and 21 for boys.
 
 

 **Amendments**
 The Act has been amended multiple times to strengthen its provisions.
 
 

 **Impact**
 Helped reduce the incidence of child marriages in India.
 
 

 **Challenges**
 Enforcement remains a challenge in many parts of the country.
